name: ConnectToExchangeServer
label: Connect to Exchange Server
description: Open a new connection to an Exchange server.

fields.name: ExchangeServerVersion
fields.label: Exchange Server Version
fields.description: The version of the Exchange server (e.g., Exchange 2013 SP1).

fields.name: ConnectionType
fields.label: Connection Type
fields.description: Specifies how to connect to the Exchange server.

selectOptions.label: Auto discovery
selectOptions.description: Uses auto-discovery with an email address.

selectOptions.label: Exchange server address
selectOptions.description: Directly connects using the server address.

fields.name: EmailAddress
fields.label: Email Address
fields.description: The email address used for auto-discovery (required if 'Connection Type' is 'Auto discovery').

fields.name: ServerAddress
fields.label: Server Address
fields.description: The direct URL or IP address of the Exchange server (required if 'Connection Type' is 'Exchange server address').

fields.name: Credentials
fields.label: Credentials
fields.description: Specifies the authentication method to use.

selectOptions.label: User defined
selectOptions.description: Uses custom domain, username, and password.

fields.name: Domain
fields.label: Domain
fields.description: The domain name for user-defined credentials (required if 'Credentials' is 'User defined').

fields.name: Username
fields.label: Username
fields.description: The username for user-defined credentials (required if 'Credentials' is 'User defined').

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: The password for user-defined credentials (required if 'Credentials' is 'User defined').

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: The timeout in seconds for the connection attempt.

fields.name: ExchangeConnection
fields.label: Exchange Connection
fields.description: The Exchange service object representing the connection to the Exchange server.
